A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 53-page versions of the same Thoth/SciRecipe work. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support comparison of equations, tables, figures and appendices A-M, including image-based material.

before.justification: v1 reports original Thoth and Thoth-mini benchmark evaluations, ablations and supplementary analyses in Section 4 and Appendices J-K.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark results, ablations and supplementary analyses, including all associated tables and figures.

M1.justification: Sketch-and-Fill, SCORE's gates and reward components, and the three-stage Knowledge-to-Action training procedure remain unchanged in Section 3 and the appendices.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same SciRecipe tasks, SciRecipe-Eval, HLE, LAB-Bench, PubMedQA, BioProBench and the MMLU evaluation in Appendix K.2. No dataset, domain or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Table 1, Figure 3, Appendix J and the RL algorithm comparisons in Table 20. Bibliographic updates do not introduce new evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The evaluation design, SciRecipe-Eval difficulty rules, metrics, model configurations and training settings are unchanged, including Appendices B, F and G.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 retains the same data, reward, reasoning-paradigm and training-stage ablations. Appendix K's RL, reward and pretraining analyses and the case studies in Appendices J.1 and L are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting and run/seed disclosures are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. No uncertainty estimates, repeated-run procedures or significance tests are added or removed.

E6.justification: Reported numerical results, plotted trends and qualitative cases are identical, including Tables 1-3 and 9-23. For example, Table 1 retains AVG scores of 52.10 for Thoth and 51.10 for Thoth-mini.

T1.justification: The SCORE definitions, action-alignment construction, GRPO objective and evaluation-metric equations in Section 3 and Appendices C, D and F are unchanged. No mathematical argument or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same scientific contributions and claims about protocol generation, executability and generalization. The revised release statement does not alter these claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning executability, overthinking and transfer are unchanged. Appendix H retains the same limitations, and Appendix J.3 retains its qualification about possible BioProBench data leakage.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces a general promise to release data, code and models with a planned code-release location at the GitHub repository manglu097/Thoth. The broader release promise remains on page 10 and in Appendix G. This adds access information without establishing actual release or changing implementation details.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. Ahmadian et al. (2024) is updated from its arXiv entry to ACL publication details for the same work; other reference edits mainly concern capitalization.

P1.justification: v2 revises the abstract's final release sentence, standardizes capitalization in several references and updates bibliographic metadata and the version/date header. The scientific narrative and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The abstract reflows, and bibliography wrapping and spacing change on pages 10-13. The expanded Ahmadian entry moves the Bengio reference from page 10 to page 11. All figures, tables and appendix layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 provides a concrete intended code location and fuller publication details for an existing reference, modestly improving access guidance and bibliographic presentation. The broader data/model release promise remains intact. Scientific content and evidence are unchanged, and the PDFs still describe a future release rather than establish resource availability.
